state.loadFailed: This information could not be loaded.
state.contractUnavailable: This information is temporarily unavailable. Actions that depend on it are paused.
outcome.invalid: Some details were not accepted. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
outcome.access-restricted: This change is not available right now. The page was refreshed.
outcome.refused: You can no longer make this change. Your access and this record were refreshed.
outcome.stale: This change was not applied because the record or the Platform roster changed. Both were refreshed; review them before trying again.
outcome.contract: The response could not be verified. Reload the page before trying again.
outcome.uncertain: We could not confirm the change. The page was refreshed; check the result before trying again.
restriction.self-target: Use your own account pages for this.
restriction.protected-root: Only a root administrator can change a root administrator.
restriction.system-role: The root role cannot be changed.
restriction.self-held-role: You hold this role, so you cannot change its grants or delete it.
restriction.lifecycle: This action is not available in the current state.
restriction.prerequisite: Only a current root administrator can do this.
restriction.access-unverified: This action is unavailable until this person's protection can be confirmed.
roster.title: Platform people
roster.description: Everyone who operates the Edara Platform. Access comes only from the roles each person holds.
roster.name: Name
invite.title: Invite a Platform person
invite.description: They receive an invitation email and start with no role. A root administrator assigns their access.
invite.descriptionRoot: They receive an invitation email. You can give them roles now or later.
invite.rolesUnavailable: Roles could not be loaded. You can assign them after the invitation.
person.noChanges: There are no changes to save.
account.title: Account and access
account.invitation.title: Resend the invitation to {{name}}?
account.invitation.description: {{name}} receives a new invitation email. Any earlier invitation link stops working.
account.recovery.title: Require {{name}} to set a new password?
account.recovery.description: {{name}} is signed out everywhere and must set a new password from a recovery email before working again.
account.recovery.done: {{name}} must now set a new password.
account.suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
account.suspend.description: {{name}} is signed out and cannot sign in or use any Platform access until unsuspended.
account.unsuspend.title: Unsuspend {{name}}?
account.unsuspend.description: {{name}} can sign in again with the roles they still hold.
account.delete.title: Remove {{name}} from the Platform?
account.delete.description: {{name}} permanently loses Platform access. This cannot be undone from here.
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.revokeConfirm.title: Sign out {{device}}?
sessions.revokeConfirm.description: {{name}} is signed out on {{device}} and must sign in again there.
sessions.revokeAllConfirm.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere?
sessions.revokeAllConfirm.description: Every session {{name}} has is ended. They must sign in again on each device.
roles.title: Platform roles
roles.description: Roles bundle Platform actions. Anyone may inspect them with read access; only a root administrator changes them.
roles.none: No role is assigned. This person has no Platform work access.
roles.expiryHint: Leave empty for access that does not expire.
roles.expiryPast: Choose a time in the future.
roles.assignConfirm.title: Give {{name}} the {{role}} role?
roles.assignConfirm.description: {{name}} gains every action in {{role}} on their next request.
roles.assignConfirm.root: {{name}} becomes a root administrator with full authority over the Platform, including roles and other administrators.
roles.revokeConfirm.title: Remove {{role}} from {{name}}?
roles.revokeConfirm.description: {{name}} loses the actions of {{role}} on their next request. The Platform always keeps at least one root administrator.
roles.create.title: Create a Platform role
roles.create.description: Choose the actions this role grants. Root authority actions can never be part of a custom role.
role.rootAccess: The root role holds every Platform action and cannot be changed.
role.deleteHint: A role that anyone still holds cannot be deleted.
role.deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{role}}?
role.grantsConfirm.title: Change the actions of {{role}}?
role.grantsConfirm.description: {{added}} actions are added and {{removed}} removed for everyone holding {{role}}, on their next request.
